Memory slopes come from a 300000 ms window and cannot distinguish warm-up from a leak (e.g., frontend slope_per_second 4262.8167741935483870961935483870962 bytes).

The generator throttle violation finding spans 27 cells from 1790627160000 to 1790627430000, ending 30000 ms before the window end, while the resource summary series covers 30/30 cells; the two evidence items cover slightly different spans.
Latency figures are per-label aggregate percentiles over the run; no per-sample distributions or anomaly-test results are provided, so distribution shape and outliers are unverified.
Throughput ratios use the full run duration as denominator (358231) rather than the evaluation window; they are run-level averages, not in-window rates.

All hypotheses here are candidate explanations, not proven causes; no causal attribution to generator throttling or any other event is established by this evidence, and error counts (0 overall) do not support impact attribution.
